card.title: Dictation
card.description: Press a shortcut anywhere to dictate. Your speech is transcribed on this computer, cleaned up by a local model, and copied to the clipboard.
card.remoteDescription: Press a shortcut anywhere to dictate. Your speech is transcribed on this computer, cleaned up, and copied to the clipboard.
card.remoteNote: The transcript is sent to your Ollama server at {server} for clean-up.

shortcut.label: Shortcut
shortcut.description: Starts and stops dictation from any app.
shortcut.turnOnFirst: Turn on dictation to use the shortcut.
shortcut.bindCommand: Bind this command to a shortcut in your system settings:

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Toggle: press the shortcut to start, and again to stop. Push to talk: hold it while you speak.
mode.holdNeedsShortcut: Push to talk needs the system shortcut.

model.label: Speech model
model.description: Turns your speech into text, on this computer.
model.unsupported: {name} can't run on this processor (missing: {features}). Choose a Parakeet model.

runtime.missing: {name} can't run: ONNX Runtime is missing ({detail}). Reinstall ChatonLM, or choose a Whisper model.
runtime.incompatible: {name} can't run: the ONNX Runtime found is not compatible ({detail}). Reinstall ChatonLM, or choose a Whisper model.
runtime.loadFailed: {name} can't run: ONNX Runtime could not be loaded ({detail}). Reinstall ChatonLM, or choose a Whisper model.

language.label: Language
language.descriptionParakeet: The language you speak. Parakeet detects the language automatically.

dictionary.label: Dictionary
dictionary.description: Names and words to spell exactly as written. Press Enter to add one.

autoCopy.label: Copy to clipboard automatically
autoCopy.description: When off, copy the text from the notification or from the last result below.

autoPaste.label: Paste where the cursor is
autoPaste.description: ChatonLM pastes the text into the app you are typing in, right after copying it. Needs automatic copy.
autoPaste.askHint: The first time, your desktop asks to let ChatonLM send the paste keystroke.

model.label: Polish model
model.description: An Ollama model cleans up the transcript: punctuation, filler words, self-corrections.
model.unreachable: Ollama is unreachable. Its models will be listed once it answers.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.description: What the polish model is told to do with your transcript.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: When off, the notification only says the text was copied.

try.label: Try dictation
try.turnOnFirst: Turn on dictation to try it.
try.chooseModel: Choose an installed speech model to try it.

lastResult.title: Last dictation
lastResult.notCopied: Not copied: select the text to copy it

polishModels.bestQuality: Best quality, needs about {size} of GPU memory
